precondition: async () => { const f=window.__prayerFixture, link=document.querySelector('link[rel="stylesheet"][href^="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?"]'); if(!link) return false; const terminal=f.assets.filter(a=>a.tagName==='LINK'&&a.url===link.href&&(a.event==='load'||a.event==='error')).at(-1); if(!terminal||(terminal.event==='load'&&link.media!=='all')) return false; f.readSnapshot(); await document.fonts.ready; const snapshot=f.readSnapshot(); return document.fonts.status==='loaded'&&snapshot.dirty===false; }
sourceBasis: Authored nonblocking stylesheet may register fonts after first render; existing font completion callbacks set dirty. Observe terminal CSS and actual native font/layout settlement before checking dirty.
